note: Round named after the ticket so parallel tickets of spec #181 do not take the same r<n>. Savar could not be reached: the implementer shipped option A (most consistent with DESIGN.md, D-087's row pattern and the r189/r190 report cards) and keeps B and C here so Savar can swap.
invariants: Copy (DESIGN.md): plain language, no performance claims, no proof we do not have. Every number is a count from the child's answers. A likely cause says the answer 'matches a common mistake'; the AI's text keeps its 'may'

A temporary harness page and email route under /dev-r198 (not committed); dev server on port 3198 with no .env.local; the card read-only, as the admin and sample reports show it

looks.decision: How the report shows strengths and struggles

options.name: Rows under 'By area': Strengths, To work on, Word problems
options.bet: Each section is its own report row (title and one-line note on the left, as D-087). Strengths: a two-column list, each with its grade, count and certainty, a leaf square. To work on: a soft grey card per struggle: topic and status chip, grade, count and certainty, then the question, the child's answer (tangerine) beside the right answer (leaf), then 'Likely cause'. The first 6 strengths and 3 struggles show; the rest fold under 'Show n more' (no JavaScript). The clear ones come first
options.benefit: Reads as more of the same report: the parent meets each struggle with the evidence in one place; the folded list keeps the page short for a child with many struggles
options.cost: Long page for a child far behind; the folded struggles need a tap

options.name: One row, side by side
options.bet: 'What [Name] can do, and what to work on': strengths on the left, struggles on the right, each struggle as one sentence ('[Name] answered 1.4; the right answer is 35') and the cause in small grey
options.benefit: Shorter; strengths and struggles read as one picture
options.cost: The answers sit inside a sentence, so the wrong and right answers are harder to scan; no room for the certainty label; cramped on tablets
options.risk: The struggles column dominates and the strengths look like an afterthought

options.name: Struggles as a table; strengths as chips
options.bet: A table like the area table: topic and status, question, the child's answer, right answer, likely cause; every strength as a leaf chip
options.benefit: Dense and scannable; every struggle visible at once
options.cost: Five narrow columns wrap long questions and causes into tall rows; does not fit a phone; the chips drop the grade, count and certainty
options.risk: Reads like a test transcript, not a report; the strengths lose their evidence

options.name: Card inside 'How we help'
options.bet: A soft grey card with the tangerine square, 'Workbook 1', under how the books help
options.benefit: Right where the report says what the books do; the plan reads as the concrete next step

looks.note: Not varied: the spec gives the sentence, and 'How we help' is the row that already says what the books do. A row of its own or a line in the overall band were considered and not built: the first repeats 'How we help', the second puts a plan before the results it rests on.
